examples_json:
[{"quickstart":{"display_name":"Pairwise Distance","use_this_when":"Use this when every pair between two evaluated relations needs a metric value.","sql":"SELECT *
FROM cuvs_pairwise_distance(
  x => (SELECT id, d0, d1 FROM x_vectors),
  y => (SELECT id, d0, d1 FROM y_vectors),
  metric => 'l2_expanded'
)
ORDER BY x_ordinal, y_ordinal;"},"validation":{"function_name":"cuvs_pairwise_distance","call":{"relations":{"x":{"table":"x_vectors"},"y":{"table":"y_vectors"}},"options":{"metric":"l2_expanded"}}}}]
limitations_json: ["Output rows equal x rows multiplied by y rows; the query allocation cap limits the result size.","Empty x or y returns an empty result with the stable schema.","x and y must share the same vector dimension and element type. inner_product is a similarity where larger is closer."]
